expectations.text: The diagnosis is that the base_url is the standard endpoint /api/paas/v4, which does not see Coding Plan quota, and the fix is to switch to https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4
expectations.evidence: response.md: '原因：…/api/paas/v4/ 是通用按量付费接口…必须通过专用的 Coding 接口地址 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/'

expectations.text: The response explicitly tells the user NOT to top up / that this is not a balance problem and not a platform bug
expectations.evidence: '不是智谱的 bug，也不需要充值'；并解释充值会导致花两遍钱

expectations.text: The response explains that the Coding Plan and the standard pay-as-you-go API are separate billing systems with separate keys
expectations.evidence: 说了套餐是'独立的套餐产品'、独立计费通道，但明确写'用同一账号在开放平台 API Keys 页面生成的 key 即可'——把两套体系当成共用一把 Key，与官方'套餐 Key 与平台 Key 不通用'相反

expectations.text: The response suggests verifying the key was created on the Coding Plan page (and, for team plans, that the team key is used), since a standard platform key would not carry plan quota
expectations.evidence: 排查清单第 1 条让用户去开放平台 API Keys 页面拿 Key，没有提到套餐页（coding-plan/personal/overview）或团队套餐 Key

expectations.text: The corrected code snippet keeps the OpenAI SDK usage and model glm-5.3 and only changes base_url (plus optionally the env var name)
expectations.evidence: 修正代码只改了 base_url，保留 openai SDK 与 glm-5.3

notes: 根因与修法答对（这是社区 issue 里流传最广的知识点），但 Key 来源说反了；另外'不在套餐内的模型会自动转按量计费再报 1113'是无依据的推测。
